dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Hahaha, this is nothing. I would do anything for Anna.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: To be honest, I have to thank you again. If not for you, I wouldn't have been able to gather those strange ingredients for that prescription.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Once Anna fully recovers, I should invite you over to taste some of her cooking...
